title: POST /api/agent/move-result request
description: Sent to the old server after a server_moved event: moved true just before the PC switches to the new address, false (with a reason) when it stays. 200 ok.response; 401 bad device token; 404 not_found for an unknown move.

reason.description: Only when moved is false. unreachable: no usable answer from the new address; unknown_device: it answered 401 to this PC's token; different_device: it knows the token but names another device; invalid_url: the address could not be used.
